Hokies on the Hill Scholarship

The Hokies on the Hill Scholarship supports Virginia Tech students who participate in the Hokies on the Hill program during the spring semester. To be considered, students must first be accepted into the program. Scholarship recipients will receive funding for the semester in which they participate. Scholarships may require demonstrated financial need, which is determined through your FAFSA submission.

Award
Varies
Deadline
11/16/2026
Supplemental Questions
  1. How will participation in the Hokies on the Hill program help you achieve your educational, career, and personal development goals? Please provide specific examples of the skills, experiences, or opportunities you hope to gain.
  2. Please write a short essay explaining your financial situation and why you need this scholarship. Be sure to share how receiving these funds would help you and how you plan to use the money to support your education, including this experience.
  3. This program takes place in Washington, D.C. for the spring semester and is not located on the main Blacksburg campus. Please describe your plan for housing during this time. For example, you might live locally in Northern Virginia, secure short-term housing, or stay with family or friends in the area.
